title: Starlink seems to be working normally again in Ukraine
summary: Elon Musk reportedly ordered SpaceX to throttle Ukraine's Starlink access.
llm_summary: Starlink service in Ukraine has returned to normal after a brief disruption that was reportedly caused by an internal directive from Elon Musk to throttle the network’s bandwidth. The slowdown, which sparked concerns about the reliability of the satellite‑internet lifeline for Ukrainian communications and defense, was lifted,
